[[Category:Inventory]]
The '''ABC method of inventory management''' is a three-tier system for managing inventory.

== Analysis ==

=== Identification ===

For each item $It_i$, identify

{| class="wikitable"
|-
| Unit value
| $v_i$
|-
| Quantity consumed over period $t$
| $Q_i$
|}

then calculate '''total value''' $V_i$ and '''value percentage'''

$$
V_i=v_iQ_i \\
\%V_i=\frac{V_i}{\sum V}
$$

=== Ordering ===

Order all items by $%V_i$ from highest to lowest to form array $(It_k)$, then calculate cumulative percentage

$$
\%CV_k=\sum_{n=1}^{k} \%V_k
$$

=== Classification ===

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! $\%CV_k$*
! Category for $It_k$
|-
| 0-75%
| A
|-
| 75-92%
| B
|-
| 92%-100%
| C
|}

<blockquote>
<nowiki/>*: Indicative value
</blockquote>
